provenance.notes: OVHcloud publishes no rate limit for its core API (eu.api.ovh.com: /domain, /order) as of 2026-11-10; the limits it documents (20 requests a second per project, 60 a minute on Keystone) are the Public Cloud OpenStack APIs', not this one: unknown, not declared. A 429 is honoured (Guzzle's exception carries the answer). The application key, secret and consumer key are required. Terms: OVHcloud's general and specific conditions; nothing read on what an API answer may be used for.
